# Spec Conventions {.unnumbered}

## File naming

Specification documents live in the `docs/` folder and are Quarto `.qmd` files
named as follows:

```
SPEC-<software-version>-<Description_of_changes>-v<NNN>.qmd
```

For example:

```
SPEC-4.0.2-Fix_tab_grouping_bugs-v001.qmd
```

Where:

- `<software-version>` — the version of TabMaster AI the spec targets
  (kept in sync with `version` in `package.json` / `manifest.json`).
- `<Description_of_changes>` — a short underscore-separated summary of what
  the spec covers.
- `v<NNN>` — the revision of the *spec document itself*, starting at `v001`.

## Revising a spec

When a spec needs to be rewritten, **do not edit the old file**. Instead, copy
it to a new file with the revision number incremented (`-v001` → `-v002`) and
make the changes there. The old revision stays in the repository and in the
rendered book, so earlier design details remain viewable.

## Adding a spec to the book

New spec files must be added to the `Specifications` part in `_quarto.yml`
(Quarto books require chapters to be listed explicitly). List newest revisions
first. Then re-render the book:

```bash
quarto render
```
